facts.text: pressure() queries IN_PV_1 and returns the decoded pressure
decode_pressure converts a Torr reply to mbar and leaves an mbar or hPa reply numerically unchanged
transducer_pressure queries IN_PV_S<channel> and transducer_pressures queries IN_PV_X
decode_pressures returns its values in millibar
config() queries IN_CFG and decode_config returns the unit, the acoustic and connection flags and the transducer counts
decode_config maps the unit digit through a table of mbar, Torr and hPa
errors() queries IN_ERR and decode_errors returns the names of the error flags that are set
version() queries IN_VER and returns the reply text
event_time_interval writes OUT_SP_1 and reads IN_SP_1; recording_time_interval writes OUT_SP_2 and reads IN_SP_2
decode_interval parses mm:ss and returns minutes*60+seconds
on_setpoint and off_setpoint accept a channel in 1 to 4, write OUT_SP_<on|off><channel> with the value in mbar and read the matching IN_SP reply
switch_on writes REMOTE 1 and switch_off writes REMOTE -
close_venting_valve writes OUT_VENT 0, open_venting_value writes OUT_VENT 1 and vent writes OUT_VENT 2
The protocol encodes every request as UTF-8 text plus a newline and strips the reply text
The protocol leaves 60 ms between commands, described as max 20 commands/s according to the documentation
An asyncio connection selects AIOProtocol, whose write_readline and write methods are coroutines
The Tango server opens the connection with connection_for_url, passes concurrency="async" and adds baudrate, bytesize and parity for serial schemes
The Tango server device properties default to baudrate 9600, bytesize 8 and parity N
The README connects through connection_for_url('serial:///dev/ttyS0') and wraps the connection in DCP3000
The README documents a serial line baudrate of 19200
